papers.title: Effect of the build angle applied in Inconel 718 alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion on the strengthening mechanisms of the micro-blasting process

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光粉末床熔融Inconel 718合金的构建角度对微喷丸强化机制的影响，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or biomedical implant context; it focuses on micro-blasting of Inconel 718 for non-biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究构建角度对LPBF Inconel 718微喷丸强化效果的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同构建角度的试样，进行微喷丸处理并分析微观组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 构建角度影响微喷丸引入的残余应力和微观结构演变，进而影响强化机制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观表征验证强化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how the build angle in laser powder bed fusion affects the strengthening mechanisms induced by micro-blasting in Inconel 718 alloy.
summary_en.method: Samples fabricated at different build angles were subjected to micro-blasting, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: The build angle significantly influences the residual stress and microstructural evolution introduced by micro-blasting, thereby altering the strengthening mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: The strengthening effects were validated through mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: The combined impact of tranexamic acid protocol and drainage on blood loss in primary total hip arthroplasty a retrospective cohort study

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于全髋关节置换术中的止血药物与引流方案，与股骨假体生物力学、应力遮挡或有限元分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling; it is purely a clinical retrospective study on blood loss management.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估氨甲环酸联合引流对全髋置换术后失血的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列分析，比较不同止血与引流方案的患者失血量。
summary_zh.result: 联合方案显著减少失血，但未涉及生物力学指标。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者数据的回顾性统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the combined effect of tranexamic acid protocol and drainage on perioperative blood loss in primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing blood loss outcomes across different combinations of tranexamic acid administration and drainage strategies.
summary_en.result: The combined protocol significantly reduced blood loss, but no biomechanical outcomes were assessed.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through retrospective analysis of patient records.

papers.title: Thermomechanical Field Prediction in Subbase Materials Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: To address the complexities associated with highly nonlinear phase transitions in subbase materials subjected to unidirectional freezing—where direct observation of internal states is challenging—and the limitations of conventional numerical methods in concurrently reconstructing multiphysical fields from sparse experimental data, this study investigates saturated subbase materials from the Dashixia Project. Laboratory freezing experiments were performed, and a two-dimensional axisymmetric physics-informed neural network (PINN) model integrating thermomechanical behavior, phase transition, and deformation was developed. The model incorporated the heat conduction equation (accounting for latent heat), the freezing fraction relaxation equation, and the effective deformation equation into the loss function, employing a continuous freezing fraction to represent phase-change phenomena. Additionally, constraints on the average displacement of the top surface, enhanced sampling near the freezing front, and a dynamic weighting strategy were introduced to improve model performance. This approach enabled the simultaneous prediction of temperature, freezing fraction, and displacement fields. The model achieved a temperature prediction root mean square error (RMSE) of 4.112 °C with an R2 of 0.600, and a top-surface displacement prediction RMSE of 0.0051 with an R2 of 0.993. Observations indicated that the freezing front predominantly progressed from the top downward, while the displacement field exhibited a partitioned pattern characterized by negative displacement in the lower region and positive displacement in the upper region. The proposed methodology offers a novel framework for multi-field reconstruction and frost heave prediction in subgrade materials under conditions of limited observational data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了PINN在岩土材料多物理场重建中的应用，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学场景。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, bone-implant interface, or any biomedical context; it focuses on geotechnical freezing problems, and lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling beyond simple displacement constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决冻土材料多物理场难以直接观测和传统数值方法重建困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 构建二维轴对称PINN，将热传导、相变和变形方程嵌入损失函数，并引入动态加权和冻结前沿加密采样。
summary_zh.result: 同时预测温度、冻结分数和位移场，位移预测精度高（R2=0.993），温度预测较差（R2=0.600）。
summary_zh.validation: 利用实验室冻结实验数据验证模型预测的位移和温度场。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of reconstructing multiphysical fields in subbase materials under unidirectional freezing, where direct observation is difficult and conventional numerical methods are limited.
summary_en.method: A two-dimensional axisymmetric physics-informed neural network (PINN) was developed, embedding heat conduction, phase transition, and deformation equations into the loss function, with dynamic weighting and enhanced sampling near the freezing front.
summary_en.result: The model simultaneously predicted temperature, freezing fraction, and displacement fields, achieving high accuracy for displacement (R2=0.993) but lower accuracy for temperature (R2=0.600).
summary_en.validation: The model was validated against laboratory freezing experiments on saturated subbase materials from the Dashixia Project.

papers.title: InSAR-Based Prediction of Time-Series Displacements Using a New Physics-Informed Neural Network with Prior Parameter Inversion
papers.abstract: Deep learning algorithms have become useful tools for predicting time-series displacements from historical displacements measured using interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) techniques. However, nearly all existing InSAR-related studies are based on data-driven deep learning algorithms, causing poor robustness, especially for long-term prediction with small-scale training samples. In this study, we propose a new algorithm, named physics-informed neural network with prior parameter inversion (PINNPI), for InSAR-based prediction of time-series displacements. PINNPI is a hybrid data-driven and knowledge-guided deep learning network, where two coupled deep neural networks are first constructed for network training and parameter inversion of prior knowledge. The outputs of these two deep neural networks are coupled by an automatic differentiation module. By minimizing a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven loss function, the proposed network simultaneously models time-series displacement and estimates prior parameters. Subsequently, time-series displacements are predicted based on the trained networks and inverted parameters. The incorporation of physical knowledge into PINNPI enhances the capability of long-term displacement prediction with respect to data-driven learning algorithms. In addition, PINNPI effectively improves the poor robustness of classical PINNs, when prior parameters are unknown. Simulations and two real-world tests suggest that the accuracy of displacement prediction by PINNPI is, on average, 85% and 88% higher than that of classical data-driven deep learning and PINN algorithms, respectively. This work offers a new insight for predicting InSAR-based displacements associated with anthropogenic and geophysical activities.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on InSAR displacement prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有数据驱动深度学习预测InSAR位移鲁棒性差，长期预测精度不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINNPI，耦合两个神经网络进行训练与参数反演，通过自动微分耦合，混合物理与数据损失。
summary_zh.result: 预测精度较数据驱动和经典PINN分别提高85%和88%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟和两个真实InSAR案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing data-driven deep learning methods for InSAR displacement prediction suffer from poor robustness, especially for long-term forecasting with limited training data.
summary_en.method: The proposed PINNPI integrates two coupled neural networks for training and prior parameter inversion, linked by automatic differentiation and trained with a hybrid physics-informed and data-driven loss.
summary_en.result: PINNPI improves prediction accuracy by 85% and 88% on average compared to data-driven deep learning and classical PINN, respectively.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through simulations and two real-world InSAR displacement datasets.

papers.title: LPBF Fabrication of 17-4 PH Stainless Steel TPMS Structures and Wettability of Surface-Treated Flat Plates
papers.abstract: This study investigates the laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) fabrication of 17-4 PH stainless steel triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) structures and the wettability response of corresponding flat plates subjected to selected post-processing treatments. Five TPMS geometries were fabricated and visually examined to document their overall condition and manufacturing irregularities. Thermal aging, steel shot blasting, commercial hydrophobic coating, and selected treatment combinations were evaluated on flat plates manufactured using the same material and LPBF process. Wettability was assessed using time-dependent static contact angle (CA) measurements and a preliminary comparison of three steel shot grades. The fabricated TPMS structures retained their overall geometries but exhibited localized burnt edges, distortion of thin boundary features, and differences in surface appearance. The untreated LPBF-fabricated surface was hydrophilic and exhibited time-dependent wetting, with the CA decreasing from approximately 81° to as low as 48° within 4 min and complete wetting occurring within approximately 8–10 min. Among the evaluated blasting media, S-330 produced the highest CA values; however, blasted surfaces remained hydrophilic, and the response depended on whether the plate was untreated or aged. The coating produced CA of approximately 153–170° across all coated regions, both with and without prior blasting. These findings identify manufacturing considerations for LPBF-fabricated TPMS structures and demonstrate the effects of the investigated treatments on the wettability of corresponding flat surfaces, thereby providing insights for future studies of TPMS-based condensation surfaces in atmospheric water generation applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制造TPMS结构和表面润湿性，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学植入物关键问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on wettability for water condensation applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索LPBF制造TPMS结构及表面处理对润湿性的影响，用于大气水收集。
summary_zh.method: 制造五种TPMS结构并评估热处理、喷砂和疏水涂层对平板润湿性的影响。
summary_zh.result: TPMS结构存在局部烧边和变形；未处理表面亲水且随时间润湿，涂层后接触角达153-170°。
summary_zh.validation: 通过静态接触角测量和视觉检查验证制造质量和润湿性。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to investigate LPBF fabrication of TPMS structures and the effects of post-processing treatments on surface wettability for potential atmospheric water generation applications.
summary_en.method: Five TPMS geometries were fabricated via LPBF, and flat plates were subjected to thermal aging, steel shot blasting, hydrophobic coating, and combinations; wettability was characterized by time-dependent contact angle measurements.
summary_en.result: TPMS structures showed localized defects, untreated surfaces were hydrophilic with time-dependent wetting, and hydrophobic coating achieved high contact angles (153-170°).
summary_en.validation: Validation was based on visual inspection of TPMS structures and contact angle measurements on treated flat plates.
